description: Turns an OpenCode chat into Jira activity: automatically extracts billable work-sessions from the chat history, rounds durations up to 15-minute increments, and lets you create Jira issues, append worklogs, and drive tickets through workflow transitions — all from natural-language triggers inside the chat, with a dry-run preview before any write.
installation:
Add the plugin to `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "plugin": [
    "opencode-time-logger@git+https://github.com/AlexMKX/opencode-time-logger.git"
  ]
}
```

OpenCode pulls the package on the next start. The skill `jira-time-tracker` and the tool `time_logger_extract_sessions` become available automatically.

### Prerequisites

- At least one Jira MCP server reachable from OpenCode (official Atlassian MCP and/or [`mcp-jira`](https://github.com/sooperset/mcp-atlassian)).
- A `supermemory` MCP server for per-project knowledge (project key, issue type, last known closed status, active ticket, etc.).
